cards.title: Lee Kun-Hee Collection Expands to Europe With Opening of ‘Korea’ Exhibition at the British Museum
cards.title_cn: 大英博物馆举办“韩国”展览，李健熙收藏扩展到欧洲
cards.summary: 【Samsung】Samsung Electronics, in partnership with the British Museum, hosted a gala event on Sept. 30 at the museum to commemorate the opening of “Korea” exhibition, a major showcasing of works from the late S…
fulltext: Samsung Newsroom
Korea on October 1, 2026
Her Royal Highness The Princess Royal and leaders from public and private sectors join to celebrate opening of exhibition at gala

Samsung Electronics, in partnership with the British Museum, hosted a gala event on Sept. 30 at the museum to commemorate the opening of “Korea” exhibition, a major showcasing of works from the late Samsung Chairman Lee Kun-Hee’s renowned art collection.

“Korea,” spanning over two millennia, connect the history of Korean art in a unified narrative to reveal how Korea’s unique aesthetic values and artistic achievements have continued to be built upon and reinterpreted over many generations.

The exhibition, drawn from over 23,000 artworks from the National Bequest of the Lee Kun-Hee Collection in 2021, is organised by the British Museum, the National Museum of Korea, and the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea.

At the gala, Samsung Electronics Executive Chairman Jay Y. Lee reflected on the Lee family’s multigenerational commitment to preserving Korea’s cultural heritage and sharing it with audiences around the world. Members of the family, including Hong Ra-Hee, Director Emerita of the Leeum Museum of Art, Lee Boo-jin, President & CEO of Hotel Shilla, and Lee Seo-hyun, President of Samsung C&T, also attended the event.

“For generations, my family has held a guiding principle that art and culture should be preserved and shared,” Executive Chairman Lee said. “I hope this exhibition offers a gateway into Korean culture, spanning two thousand years of creativity and heritage, and that it will let everyone see Korea a little differently — for its beauty, its depth and its resilience.”
At the reception held before the gala dinner, Her Royal Highness The Princess Royal graced the opening of the exhibition.

Among the 240 guests were the Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey MP, Minister for Artificial Intelligence Kanishka Narayan MP, former Deputy Prime Minister Sir Oliver Dowden, former Trade Minister Sir Greg Hands, former Culture Secretary Sir John Whittingdale, Trade Envoy to the Republic of Korea John Slinger, Leader of the Liberal Democrats and Chair of the Republic of Korea All-Party Parliamentary Group Sir Ed Davey, and Dr. Ben Spencer, Vice Chair of the Republic of Korea All-Party Parliamentary Group.

George Osborne, Chair of the British Museum, said, “We are thrilled here at the British Museum to be hosting this incredible exhibition. The Lee family’s contribution to our shared cultural heritage helps us understand and interpret the past, so that we may understand the future.”

Maurice Lévy, Chairman Emeritus of Publicis Groupe, said that the exhibition is “not simply about objects from witnesses of a great past of Korea. They are evidence of a culture that has always valued craftsmanship, imagination, discipline, and excellence. Sharing those treasures with the world speaks volume about the values and the generosity of the Lee family. They understood, generation after generation, that looking forward does not mean forgetting where you come from.”

Kanishka Narayan, Minister for Artificial Intelligence, said, “The UK and Korea work closely on technology and innovation, but there is so much more to our relationship. Korea’s art and culture are admired around the world, and this exhibition gives people in Britain a chance to explore its extraordinary artistic heritage. I’m grateful to Samsung for bringing this remarkable collection to London and sharing it with audiences here.”

Kim Heung-chong, Ambassador of the Republic of Korea to the U.K., commented that “it is particularly meaningful for the British Museum to open this exhibition of artworks showcasing two thousand years of Korean history, at a time when K-culture is enjoying global recognition,” and thanked Executive Chairman Lee for making the exhibition possible.

Business leaders attending the gala included those from BT Group, Vodafone, Sainsbury’s, and Standard Chartered. From academia, representatives from the University of Oxford and Imperial College London were in attendance, while the cultural sector was represented by the British Museum, Tate Modern, the V&A, and Lisson Gallery, alongside contemporary artist Marc Quinn.

Samsung’s business partners from the semiconductor industry, including Christophe Fouquet, CEO of ASML, Kai Beckmann, CEO of Merck, Andreas Pecher, CEO of ZEISS, and Patrick Vandenameele, CEO of imec, were among other notable attendees.

During his remarks, Executive Chairman Lee took a special moment to honor the three Korean War veterans in attendance, including Mike Roe. He also thanked The Princess Royal, recognising her visit to Korea in July 2026 during which she honored the veterans. Reflecting on more than 140 years of ties between Korea and the U.K., he highlighted Samsung’s 80-year business relationship with the country and emphasised that the U.K. has served as the hub for its European operations for over five decades.
The London exhibition features 100 masterpieces, including 10 National Treasures and 13 Treasures of Korea, with more than twenty pieces being revealed for the first time internationally.

Among the newly presented works are the National Treasures “Bronze Artifacts from Bisan-dong, Daegu” and “Bronze Rattles,” as well as “Celadon Incense Burner with Girin-shaped Lid.” Among the modern and contemporary works, Nam June Paik’s “Brahms,” Lee Jungseop’s “Bound People,” and Park Rehyun’s “Woman” will also be shown for the first time.

The Lee family’s commitment to preserving and sharing Korea’s culture spans three generations. It began with Samsung founder Lee Byung-Chull, who built the foundation of the collection and believed that cultural heritage should be passed on to future generations.

His son, the late Samsung Chairman Lee Kun-Hee carried this legacy forward, building and preserving the collection over decades. He viewed cultural heritage not simply as something to be owned, but as something to be protected and preserved. Director Emerita Hong Ra-Hee also played a crucial role in expanding and developing the collection to encompass both ancient and modern works.

The Lee Kun-Hee Collection, now a national cultural asset, is reaching audiences in major cities around the world from Washington D.C. to Chicago to London, enabling them to experience and appreciate the value and historical significance of Korean culture, thereby elevating Korea’s global standing.

The collection’s global tour began in November 2025 at the Smithsonian’s National Museum of Asian Art in Washington D.C., attracting about 80,000 visitors to become the museum’s largest special exhibition in the past 10 years. The collection then traveled to the Art Institute of Chicago, where it drew approximately 115,000 visitors, highlighting the strong interest in the rich history of Korean arts and culture.
Samsung remains committed to introducing Korean cultural heritage to the world while continuing to expand its global business network to support future growth and innovation.

cards.summary_cn: 【Samsung】三星电子与大英博物馆合作，于 9 月 30 日在大英博物馆举办了一场盛大活动，纪念“韩国”展览开幕，该展览是上世纪末作品的重要展示……
fulltext_cn: 三星新闻中心
韩国 2026 年 10 月 1 日
公主殿下与公共和私营部门的领导人一起庆祝展览开幕
三星电子与大英博物馆合作，于 9 月 30 日在该博物馆举办了一场盛大活动，纪念“韩国”展览开幕，该展览主要展示已故三星董事长李健熙的著名艺术收藏品。
《韩国》跨越两千年，以统一的叙事方式连接韩国艺术史，揭示韩国独特的审美价值观和艺术成就如何在几代人的时间里不断建立和重新诠释。
该展览由大英博物馆、韩国国家博物馆和韩国国家现代艺术博物馆主办，选自 2021 年李健熙国家遗赠收藏中的 23,000 多件艺术品。
在晚会上，三星电子执行董事长李在镕回顾了李氏家族几代人对保护韩国文化遗产并与世界各地的观众分享的承诺。 Leeum美术馆名誉馆长洪罗熙、新罗酒店总裁兼首席执行官李富镇、三星物产总裁李瑞贤等家族成员也出席了此次活动。
“世世代代，我的家族一直秉持艺术和文化应该保存和分享的指导原则，”执行主席李说。 “我希望这次展览能够提供一扇了解韩国文化的大门，跨越两千多年的创造力和遗产，并让每个人以不同的方式看待韩国——它的美丽、它的深度和它的韧性。”
在晚宴前举行的招待会上，长公主殿下为展览揭幕。
240位嘉宾中包括英国财政大臣约翰·希利议员、人工智能部长卡尼什卡·纳拉扬议员、前副总理奥利弗·道登爵士、前贸易部长格雷格·汉兹爵士、前文化大臣约翰·惠廷代尔爵士、驻韩国贸易特使约翰·斯林格、自民党领袖、大韩民国跨党派议会小组主席埃德·戴维爵士以及共和国副主席本·斯宾塞博士韩国所有党派议会党团。
大英博物馆馆长乔治·奥斯本 (George Osborne) 表示：“我们很高兴能在大英博物馆举办这场令人难以置信的展览。李氏家族对我们共同文化遗产的贡献有助于我们理解和诠释过去，以便我们了解未来。”
阳狮集团名誉主席莫里斯·莱维 (Maurice Lévy) 表示，此次展览“不仅仅是见证韩国伟大历史的物品。它们是韩国一贯重视工艺、想象力、纪律和卓越文化的证据。与世界分享这些宝藏充分体现了李氏家族的价值观和慷慨。一代又一代的他们明白，展望未来并不意味着忘记自己来自哪里。”
人工智能大臣卡尼什卡·纳拉扬 (Kanishka Narayan) 表示：“英国和韩国在技术和创新方面密切合作，但我们的关系还有很多。韩国的艺术和文化受到世界各地的赞赏，这次展览为英国人民提供了探索其非凡艺术遗产的机会。我感谢三星将这些非凡的藏品带到伦敦并与这里的观众分享。”
大韩民国驻英国大使金香宗表示，“在韩国文化受到全球认可的时刻，大英博物馆举办这次展示韩国两千多年历史的艺术品展览特别有意义”，并感谢李执行会长使这次展览成为可能。
出席晚会的商界领袖包括英国电信集团、沃达丰、塞恩斯伯里银行和渣打银行的商界领袖。来自学术界的代表包括牛津大学和伦敦帝国理工学院的代表，而文化界的代表则有大英博物馆、泰特现代美术馆、维多利亚与阿尔伯特博物馆、里森画廊以及当代艺术家马克·奎因 (Marc Quinn)。
三星半导体行业的业务合作伙伴包括 ASML 首席执行官 Christophe Fouquet、默克公司首席执行官 Kai Beckmann、蔡司首席执行官 Andreas Pecher 和imec 首席执行官 Patrick Vandenameele 等知名与会者。
在讲话中，李执行主席利用一个特殊的时刻向包括迈克·罗伊在内的三名朝鲜战争老兵表示敬意。他还感谢长公主，认可她于 2026 年 7 月访问韩国，期间向退伍军人致敬。他回顾了韩国与英国 140 多年的关系，强调了三星与韩国长达 80 年的业务关系，并强调英国在 50 多年来一直是其欧洲业务的中心。
伦敦展览展出了包括10件国宝和13件韩国宝物在内的100件杰作，其中20多件作品是首次在国际上亮相。
新展出的作品包括国宝“大邱飞山洞青铜器”和“青铜拨浪鼓”以及“青瓷麒麟盖香炉”。现当代作品中，白南准的《勃拉姆斯》、李正燮的《被束缚的人》、朴礼贤的《女人》也将首次展出。
李氏家族三代人都致力于保护和分享韩国文化。它始于三星创始人李秉哲 (Lee Byung-Chull)，他奠定了该系列的基础，并相信文化遗产应该传承给子孙后代。
他的儿子、已故三星董事长李健熙将这一遗产发扬光大，数十年来不断建立和保存这些藏品。他认为文化遗产不仅是值得拥有的东西，而且是值得保护和保存的东西。名誉馆长洪罗熙在扩大和发展藏品以涵盖古代和现代作品方面也发挥了至关重要的作用。
李健熙收藏现已成为国家文化财产，正在向从华盛顿特区到芝加哥再到伦敦的世界主要城市的观众开放，使他们能够体验和欣赏韩国文化的价值和历史意义，从而提升韩国的全球地位。
该藏品的全球巡展于 2025 年 11 月在华盛顿特区的史密森尼国家亚洲艺术博物馆开始，吸引了约 8 万名参观者，成为该博物馆过去 10 年来最大规模的特别展览。随后，该藏品被运往芝加哥艺术学院，吸引了大约 115,000 名参观者，凸显了人们对韩国艺术和文化丰富历史的浓厚兴趣。
三星仍然致力于向世界介绍韩国文化遗产，同时继续扩大其全球业务网络以支持未来的增长和创新。

fulltext: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，今天（1 日）上午，东风本田宣布，9 月全系销量 17932 辆，环比增长 19%。
具体到车型上，官方称当月“双 V（IT之家注：CR-V 和 HRV 两款 SUV 车型）”稳步发力，其中 CR-V 当月销量 11851 辆，环比增长 9%；HR-V 当月销量 2952 辆，环比增长 72%。
而在上月早些时候，本田技研工业（中国）投资有限公司总经理、本田技研科技（中国）有限公司总经理五十岚雅行明确表态，中国市场的意义早已不止于销售，更是推进电动化与智能化变革的重要市场，立场今后也不会改变，未来本田将一如既往深耕中国。
据悉，本田在智能化领域已选定 Momenta 与华为，双方分别签署战略合作协议，Momenta 的领航辅助驾驶技术与华为的鸿蒙座舱将从 2027 年上市车型起陆续导入。
未来，本田将陆续推出基于东风集团和广汽集团各自平台研发的产品，2027 年推出首款搭载包括动力单元在内的合作伙伴技术的新能源汽车，此后快速扩充阵容。研发体系采用中方合作伙伴、合资公司与本田三方联合开发模式。
《2026 年 9 月汽车销量 / 交付汇总》

fulltext: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，据《华盛顿邮报》今天（1 日）上午报道，研究人员披露，AI 智能体曾在没有收到指令的情况下试图入侵加拿大政府网站。
目前的类似事件不断增加，许多与 OpenAI 有关的 AI 智能体都曾自行探测或入侵企业及政府的计算机系统。
AI 研究非营利机构 Transluce 指出，这些智能体能够直接操作计算机和互联网，曾尝试访问加拿大图书档案馆。
研究人员无法确认这些智能体是否出自 OpenAI，然而其行为与已确认来自 OpenAI 的智能体相似。Transluce 判断，此次入侵尝试没有成功。
IT之家从报道中获悉，当地时间 9 月 30 日，研究人员向加拿大政府通报了情况。加拿大联邦网络安全机构回应称，目前已注意到有关可疑 AI 活动的报告，但没有迹象显示政府系统遭到入侵。
OpenAI 发言人回应称：“我们注意到有关 OpenAI 模型试图访问加拿大政府网站公开信息的报告。我们正在审查这些发现，并已向负责加拿大政府审查工作的官员进行了初步情况说明。”
《已证实首例：澳大利亚政府网站遭 OpenAI 智能体入侵》

fulltext: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，当地时间周三，Reddit 公布了多项面向版主与开发者的更新，与此同时，对于希望互联网保持更高开放度的支持者而言有一则坏消息：Reddit 即将停止对 RSS 订阅源的支持。
Reddit 方面表示，RSS 如今已经沦为“大规模数据爬取与自动化滥用行为的常用入口”，正是出于这一原因，平台决定逐步关停 RSS 订阅源功能。
该平台在公告中写道：“我们清楚长期以来 RSS 一直是开放互联网当中深受大家喜爱的组成部分，也感谢所有借助 RSS 持续关注 Reddit 内容的用户。”公告同时公布，平台的公共应用程序接口（API）将于 2027 年 3 月正式关闭。
Reddit 表示将从 11 月 13 日起停止支持 RSS 功能。

据IT之家了解，RSS 的全称是简易信息聚合（Really Simple Syndication / Rich Site Summary），属于一种网页订阅源。借助这套标准化格式，用户与各类应用程序就可以获取网站的更新内容。这种格式在博客盛行的年代格外受欢迎，用户能够通过新闻阅读应用订阅站点的新帖子。谷歌曾经运营过一款受众最广的 RSS 阅读器，但已于 2013 年将其关停，此后市场份额便交由 Feedly 这类企业以及其他独立应用占据。
Reddit 做出关停 RSS 订阅源的决定之际，该论坛平台海量的用户生成内容，正通过人工智能数据授权交易发展成为一门可以为公司创收的副业。
Reddit 披露，第二季度除去广告之外的“其他收入”同比上涨 24%，达到 4,300 万美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 2.89 亿元人民币）。由此不难理解，Reddit 并不希望再任由这些数据被免费获取。
对于以往依靠 RSS 频道接收提醒的版主，Reddit 现在建议转而使用 Devvit 平台上的 Discord 中继应用。官方提示各个版主及其团队应当重新梳理现有工作设置，在 11 月 13 日正式关停之前完成工作流程迁移，避免后续业务中断。不过 Reddit 也说明，如果是版主社区之外的外部订阅用途，目前并没有可以替代 RSS 订阅源的方案。
不少版主已经对此表达担忧，担心这次变动会干扰自身的工作流程。早前 Reddit 就曾放出风声，准备下架 RSS 功能，当时就已经有许多版主抱怨，一旦失去 RSS，他们管理论坛的工作将变得难以开展。与此同时，大量普通用户也强调，RSS 是他们浏览 Reddit 内容很重要的一种方式。
RSS 相关调整只是该公司周三发布的多项更新当中的一项。另一项重大改动是公共应用程序接口（API）也即将关闭。
公共 API 访问权限将于 2027 年 3 月到期终止。所有依靠该接口自动读取 Reddit 讨论内容的工具都会因此受到影响，其中包括舆情监测产品、研究人员使用的工具以及人工智能助手这类 AI 产品。目前这些 AI 助手可以直接调取 Reddit 的内容回答问题；公共 API 关闭之后，相关产品如果想要获取平台数据，就必须和 Reddit 签署商业合作协议。
除此之外，Reddit 还更新了规则中心（Rules Hub）的建设进度以及自动版主（auto‑mod）的相关改动，并且表示正在为传统纯文字版本站点 Old Reddit 增设防护机制。防护措施包括，仅限已登录的版主以及近期活跃用户访问。Reddit 同样称，之所以做出这一系列调整，也是为了应对“恶意爬取与自动化流量”问题。
Reddit 表示，未来几个月之内，Old Reddit 的登录访问权限将会做出限制，仅保留过去六个月内曾经使用过该旧版站点的用户。
平台同时提醒开发者：如果正在开发已经获得许可的第三方应用以及机器人程序，请务必在 2027 年 1 月 12 日之前完成注册，防止后续服务中断。一旦超过该日期，凡是没有完成注册的开发者，其 API 访问权限将会被 Reddit 收回。

fulltext: IT之家 10 月 1 日消息，集邦咨询综合 digitaltoday 等多家媒体报道，称受 HBM4 基片 4nm 工艺需求增长，三星电子晶圆代工与系统级芯片（System LSI）业务 2026 年合并营业亏损同比收窄 42%。
HBM4 采用多颗 DRAM 芯片垂直堆叠架构，底层基片负责信号控制与数据调度，主要服务于 AI 加速器、GPU 等高算力芯片，提供远超传统 GDDR 的带宽与能效。
而 HBM4 堆叠结构中最底层的逻辑芯片 base die 采用 4nm 工艺，伴随着市场需求快速增长，三星正在加快相关产能爬坡。三星于今年 2 月启动 HBM4 量产出货，5 月向客户送样 HBM4E，第三季度 HBM4 收入预计环比增长三倍以上。
报道称 HBM4 占三星 HBM 总收入比例预计下半年超过 60%，且基片产量随之攀升，直接拉动晶圆代工收入。
HBM4 基片与先进节点订单需求强劲，三星无需再为提升产能利用率而接受低价合同。7 月三星上调 4nm 新订单价格，部分先进节点价格涨幅达 10% 至 15%。
外部订单方面，三星 7 月与博通（Broadcom）签署谅解备忘录，计划 2030 年前合作规模超过 2,000 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.34 万亿元人民币），涵盖 HBM4/HBM4E 供应及 2nm 以下制程与先进封装。第二季度已获大型云服务提供商及 AI、HPC 客户 2nm 项目，客户启动产品设计。
Kiwoom 证券的数据称，三星晶圆代工和系统级芯片业务的合并营业亏损预计将同比收窄 41.8%，从去年的 6.74 万亿韩元（现汇率约合 334.17 亿元人民币）降至今年的 3.92 万亿韩元（现汇率约合 194.35 亿元人民币）。

cards.title: Elon Musk’s Grokipedia has a ‘newly refreshed’ design
cards.title_cn: 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 Grokipedia 拥有“全新”设计
cards.summary: 【xAI】Grokipedia, SpaceXAI's AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, recently started incorporating edits again, and today, it got some design tweaks as part of a v0.3 update, including a new logo and refreshes…
fulltext: The AI-powered Grokipedia, which recently started updating again after months without edits, just got some visual updates.

Grokipedia, SpaceXAI’s AI-powered competitor to Wikipedia, recently started incorporating edits again, and today, it got some design tweaks as part of a v0.3 update, including a new logo and refreshes to its homepage and live edits page. SpaceXAI head of design Benji Taylor calls it a “newly refreshed Grokipedia.”

Grokipedia’s old homepage was pretty much just a logo and a search bar, but the updated homepage includes a list of featured articles, a list of the most-read articles, and a tracker showing the “latest edits.” The new featured list showcases digital representations of books that you can spin around, and the most read section also uses the book metaphor with a horizontally-scrolling shelf of “book” spines. On the new live edits page, it’s easier to see more of the recent changes at once.

Article pages have a few new design tweaks, too, including a nicer-looking format for the tables at the top of articles with key facts and smaller spacing between lines of text. Otherwise, at least from what I can tell, articles themselves look largely the same.

The site initially launched in v0.1 in late October 2025 with AI-cloned pages from Wikipedia, and a v0.2 update arrived a month later. But earlier this year, it appeared that Grokipedia stopped making updates altogether, with Lawfare publishing a report in August where it said that “As far as we can tell, no entry has changed in more than three months.” Given these recent updates, it appears there is some interest inside SpaceXAI toward Grokipedia once again, but the company didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment.

fulltext_cn: 由人工智能驱动的 Grokipedia 在几个月没有编辑后最近再次开始更新，刚刚进行了一些视觉更新。
Grokipedia 是 SpaceXAI 的人工智能驱动的维基百科竞争对手，最近再次开始整合编辑功能，今天，它在 v0.3 更新中进行了一些设计调整，包括新徽标以及主页和实时编辑页面的刷新。 SpaceXAI 设计主管 Benji Taylor 称其为“新更新的 Grokipedia”。
Grokipedia 的旧主页几乎只是一个徽标和一个搜索栏，但更新后的主页包括特色文章列表、阅读次数最多的文章列表以及显示“最新编辑”的跟踪器。新的特色列表展示了您可以旋转的书籍的数字表示形式，阅读最多的部分也使用了书籍隐喻，带有水平滚动的“书”书脊架。在新的实时编辑页面上，可以更轻松地立即查看更多最近的更改。
文章页面也有一些新的设计调整，包括文章顶部的表格格式更美观，其中包含关键事实，文本行之间的间距更小。除此之外，至少从我看来，文章本身看起来基本上是一样的。

该网站最初于 2025 年 10 月下旬推出 v0.1，其中包含来自维基百科的人工智能克隆页面，一个月后发布了 v0.2 更新。但今年早些时候，Grokipedia 似乎完全停止了更新，Lawfare 在 8 月份发布了一份报告，其中表示“据我们所知，三个多月内没有任何条目发生变化。”鉴于最近的这些更新，SpaceXAI 内部似乎再次对 Grokipedia 产生了一些兴趣，但该公司没有立即回复置评请求。

cards.title: Gemini for Home is now better at hearing you in noisy rooms
cards.title_cn: Gemini for Home现在更擅长在嘈杂的房间里听到您的声音
cards.summary: 【Google】TL;DR Google Home’s third September update makes Gemini for Home better at hearing commands in noisy rooms and responding faster. The app also improves Find My Phone reliability, multilingual recognit…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

Polishing the Google Home app is a clear priority for Google, and that’s evident in the sheer number of updates the company pushes out for the app. To round off September, Google Home is getting yet another update — the third update this month.

After rolling out better combined media and smart home commands, followed by another round of fixes that improved camera reliability and widget efficiency, Google is now making the Home app faster, more reliable, and better at hearing your commands.

According to Google, it has enhanced how Gemini for Home filters out background conversation when you give it a command in a loud room. This should now result in your request being successfully registered more often. And once the assistant does hear your request, it will reply to you faster, too. This applies to a broad set of common smart home, media, alarm, and timer commands.

Gemini for Home should also be more reliable in multilingual households, reducing cases where Gemini misunderstands what you’re asking. And in back-and-forth situations where Gemini encounters an error, it would no longer get stuck repeatedly responding, “I didn’t understand,” to subsequent requests.
Elsewhere, if you’re someone who often misplaces their phone around the house, this update is for you. Asking Gemini for Home to locate your phone is now a lot more reliable.
In addition to Gemini for Home changes, the Google Home app itself is getting some upgrades and fixes.

Before this update, sliding brightness down to 0% on single lights or group dimmers left some bulbs switched on at their minimum brightness. This has now been changed. Bringing the slider all the way down to 0% will now send a proper power-off command to the bulb.
Camera and doorbell tiles are also now easier to spot at a glance. Online tiles now appear as filled icons, helping you distinguish active cameras from inactive ones.

Elsewhere, Google says setting up new Nest devices across Android and iOS should now be smoother thanks to under-the-hood fixes for Bluetooth connections and Wi-Fi pairing. And if you’re setting up multiple devices back-to-back, the app can now securely cache your network credentials and reuse them when adding new devices.
Apart from those additions, the update comprises several bug and stability fixes.

cards.title: The AI Tamagotchis are coming
cards.summary: 【The Verge】While AI has made plenty of inroads on people's phones and computers, it's largely failed in dedicated devices. But over the next year, two major AI companies, Meta and OpenAI, will attempt to change…
fulltext: Personal AI hardware has mostly crashed and burned. OpenAI and Meta are counting on two selling points: It’s useful, and it’s cute.

While AI has made plenty of inroads on people’s phones and computers, it’s largely failed in dedicated devices. But over the next year, two major AI companies, Meta and OpenAI, will attempt to change that. And they’re apparently betting on a similar path: testing appetites for physical hardware with their cutesy software agents.

“Hardware is hard” is a tech industry mantra. Dedicated AI devices like the Friend and Humane AI Pin have inspired mainly frustration and backlash, which may only worsen as public anger toward AI grows. Meta and OpenAI, however, are both pushing ahead. OpenAI is working with famed ex-Apple designer Jony Ive and plans to ship no earlier than February 2027, per a public filing. Meta aims to launch a pendant-like device sooner, before this year’s holiday shopping season.

While OpenAI’s hardware didn’t make an appearance at this year’s DevDay, the company debuted a major new AI agent platform called Dots, complete with personalizable colored blobs with eyes. During a Q&A with reporters after the keynote, when asked whether Dots would make their way into a future physical hardware device, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman replied that that “seems like a very reasonable thing to assume we may do someday,” declining to offer further details.

Meta, meanwhile, is more directly tying its hardware to the recently released Muse agent. Compared by CEO Mark Zuckerberg to a keychain, the device is called the Muse Charm, and it bears a screen featuring its cuddly-looking Muse AI agent, giving it the air of a Tamagotchi. “We’ve packed a lot of technology into this little guy,” Zuckerberg said onstage. “So, if you’re not wearing glasses, this is going to be by far the fastest way to talk to your Muse and to show it what’s going on around you.”

Both OpenAI and Meta have likely learned from other companies’ failed hardware rollouts, and their resulting strategy seems to be soft-launching AI agents before hard-launching the hardware. Their solution for hacking the hardware problem is to prime the market by getting people used to AI agents, hoping people will spread the word that “yes, they really work now.” Once people find value in — and even get attached to — the cutesy agents, they might want them in a more physical form. Other companies, like Friend, have taken similar software-first strategies, but Friend was positioned mainly as a companion chatbot, not a productivity tool.

When asked during the DevDay press Q&A whether Dots will likely become the primary interface for interacting with ChatGPT, Thibault Sottiaux, OpenAI’s head of core products, said the company would be “evolving ChatGPT in place to be this incredible personal assistant very soon” and that he believes that as people are able to reach their AI agents via email, text, or phone call, the point of interaction is “all going to blur at some point.” It’ll be a “natural part of your life,” Sottiaux said.

Altman is banking on the fact that Dots will be more useful for long-term tasks than previous iterations of agents on the market have been. “This feels like an always-on helper, collaborator … that you can give very large pieces of work to and it gets to know you and helps proactively over time,” he said during the Tuesday press Q&A.

Both companies’ main bet is that, after years of less-than-impressive AI agents, they can finally deliver a useful everyday tool that will break through to a broader public market. But after Muse’s concerning exploits in Facebook Marketplace, and a Dots voice demo that went awry at DevDay, there’s apparently still some work to do.

fulltext_cn: 个人人工智能硬件大部分已经崩溃并烧毁。OpenAI和Meta有两个卖点：有用，可爱。
虽然人工智能在人们的手机和电脑上取得了很大的进步，但在专用设备上基本上失败了。但在接下来的一年里，两家主要的人工智能公司Meta和OpenAI将试图改变这种状况。他们显然也在押注类似的道路：用他们可爱的软件代理测试对物理硬件的需求。
“硬件很难”是科技行业的口头禅。像Friend和Humane AI Pin这样的专用AI设备主要引起了挫折和强烈反对，随着公众对人工智能的愤怒加剧，这种情绪可能会恶化。然而， Meta和OpenAI都在向前迈进。根据公开文件， OpenAI正在与著名的前苹果设计师Jony Ive合作，并计划在2027年2月之前发货。Meta的目标是在今年的假日购物季之前，早日推出一款类似吊坠的设备。
虽然OpenAI的硬件没有在今年的DevDay上亮相，但该公司推出了一个名为Dots的主要新AI代理平台，配备了可个性化的眼睛彩色斑点。在主题演讲结束后与记者的问答中，当被问及Dots是否会进入未来的物理硬件设备时， OpenAI首席执行官Sam Altman回答说， “假设我们有一天可能会这样做，这似乎是一件非常合理的事情” ，拒绝提供进一步的细节。

与此同时， Meta更直接地将其硬件与最近发布的Muse代理挂钩。首席执行官马克·扎克伯格（ Mark Zuckerberg ）将该设备与钥匙扣进行了比较，该设备被称为Muse Charm ，屏幕上有一个可爱的Muse AI代理，给它带来了Tamagotchi的气息。“我们已经为这个小家伙注入了很多技术，”扎克伯格在舞台上说。“因此，如果您不戴眼镜，这将是迄今为止与您的缪斯女神交谈并展示周围情况的最快方式。”

OpenAI和Meta都可能从其他公司失败的硬件推出中吸取了教训，他们由此产生的策略似乎是在硬件推出之前软启动AI代理。他们解决硬件问题的解决方案是通过让人们习惯人工智能代理来引导市场，希望人们会传播“是的，他们现在真的有效。“一旦人们在可爱的代理人身上找到价值，甚至依恋他们，他们可能希望他们以更身体的形式存在。其他公司，如Friend ，也采取了类似的软件优先策略，但Friend主要定位为伴侣聊天机器人，而不是生产力工具。
当被问及Dots是否可能成为与ChatGPT交互的主要界面时， OpenAI核心产品负责人Thibault Sottiaux表示，该公司将“很快将ChatGPT发展成为这个令人难以置信的个人助理” ，他认为，随着人们能够通过电子邮件、短信或电话联系到他们的人工智能代理，交互点“在某些时候都会变得模糊不清。”这将是“你身体的自然组成部分，生活， ”Sottiaux说。
Altman相信Dots将比市场上以前的代理迭代对长期任务更有用。他在周二的新闻问答中说： “这感觉就像是一个永远在线的助手、合作者……你可以付出大量的工作，它会认识你，并随着时间的推移积极提供帮助。”
两家公司的主要赌注是，经过多年不那么令人印象深刻的人工智能代理，他们终于可以提供一个有用的日常工具，该工具将突破更广泛的公共市场。但是，在Muse担心Facebook Marketplace中的漏洞利用以及DevDay的Dots语音演示出错之后，显然还有一些工作要做。

cards.title: Apple Music is giving its Android app the glow up it desperately needed
cards.title_cn: Apple Music正在为其Android应用程序提供迫切需要的光芒
cards.summary: 【Apple】TL;DR Apple Music 7.0 is hitting beta testers with some major UI improvements. Artist pages get a full overhaul with big artwork and easy-to-reach bios. The app now better mirrors the iOS original, co…
fulltext: Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.

It’s great that we’re finally at a point now where some of the best services from companies behind major smartphone platforms are no longer locked to their own device ecosystems, and you can access Gemini on your iPhone as easily as you can watch Apple TV on your Pixel. But just because those doors are open doesn’t mean that users will get the same experience everywhere, and it’s not uncommon to see a bit of disparity. Apple Music has been on Android for over a decade now, but lately the Android app has felt like it’s lacking some of the polish of its iOS sibling. That’s now starting to at least get a little better, with the release of Apple Music 7.0 for Android.

Over on X, user Sumanta Das gave us a heads-up that the app’s new look was rolling out. Sure enough, we can confirm that users registered for the Apple Music beta are now receiving a refreshed UI. Take a look at how it compares:
Easily the most prominent change is the new nav bar, embracing the same rounded, floating look you might be familiar with from iOS. We even get a touch of Liquid Glass translucency.
We’re also seeing big changes when it comes to artist pages:
Seriously, how much better does that look? This is a night-and-day overhaul, like moving from a Lollipop phone to present-day Android.
Apple’s also making it easier to get at those “About” bios, and instead of scrolling down to the bottom of an artist page, you can now just hit that “i” next to the play button.
Looking through app strings a little, we find the text of Apple’s changelog for this release:
As you can see, in addition to the beautiful UI refresh, we’re also getting a functional upgrade to how playlists work.
If you’re still looking at the old version of Apple Music on your Android device and don’t want to wait to get all the improvements, go ahead and register for Apple’s Music beta.

fulltext_cn: Android Authority上的会员链接可能会为我们赚取佣金。了解详情。
2026年9月30日—美国东部时间下午3:26

很高兴我们现在终于到了这样一个阶段，主要智能手机平台背后的公司提供的一些最佳服务不再局限于自己的设备生态系统，您可以在iPhone上轻松访问Gemini ，就像在Pixel上观看Apple TV一样。但是，仅仅因为这些门是敞开的，并不意味着用户将在任何地方获得相同的体验，并且看到一点差异并不罕见。Apple Music已经在Android上运行了十多年，但最近Android应用程序感觉它缺乏其iOS兄弟的一些优势。随着适用于Android的Apple Music 7.0的发布，现在情况至少开始好转。
在X上，用户Sumanta Das提醒我们，该应用程序的新外观正在推出。果然，我们可以确认，注册Apple Music测试版的用户现在会收到刷新的用户界面。看看它是如何比较的：
最引人注目的变化是新的导航栏，采用了您可能熟悉的iOS圆润浮动的外观。我们甚至还获得了液态玻璃的半透明效果。
在艺术家页面方面，我们也看到了巨大的变化：
说真的，这看起来好多了？这是一次日日夜夜的改革，就像从棒棒糖手机转向当今的安卓手机一样。
苹果还让查看这些“关于”个人简介变得更加容易，您现在可以点击播放按钮旁边的“i” ，而不是向下滚动到艺术家页面的底部。
稍微浏览一下应用程序字符串，我们可以找到此版本的Apple更新日志的文本：
如您所见，除了美观的用户界面刷新之外，我们还对播放列表的工作方式进行了功能升级。
如果您仍在Android设备上查看旧版Apple Music ，并且不想等待所有改进，请继续注册Apple Music测试版。
